notes.title: Some major building work in the neighborhood has been completed!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39805570/d42f44694782b70ac062b706260d1e27d281df87.jpg
Here's the list:
[olist]
Much better BJ positions and handling of the love toy
The intensity meter logic is working much better now, don't get boring with one position only
Hair for some of the characters have been improved
Camera system issues have been addressed
Moneyshot positions
[/olist]
An to top it off
The threesome has been rebuilt to offer a way better experience!
Now all characters will be actively involved in the positions!

Please let us know if you are running into issues, we love to hear your feedback.

notes.title: Lets spicy it up with some new positions
notes.content:
Is life at the suburb too boring for you?
Then it's time to hit the swimming pool and try some new sex positions.
But that's not all, we've also updated the game with following improvements:

 Better UX / UI for VR users. It is much more simplified and easier to use.
 Improved skin shader that looks much smoother and more realistic
 Better head and eye movement
 Many fixes to interpenetration and other animation issues


We are working on exciting new features which will be relased in the next few months.
So stay cool and enjoy your summer

notes.title: 📣 NEW RELEASE: Bambie! - Embrace the Plastic Magic! 🩰🎮
notes.content:
Calling all gamers and fans of enchanting adventures! Prepare to enter a world of whimsy and delight with "Bambie!". Get ready to embark on a captivating journey filled with charm, hornyness, and plastic!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39805570/6620b0c468cd7be585c9d6a9879eadac46e329b9.jpg

Meet Barbara, our delightful protagonist, and her fabulous friends: Chelsea, the caring dentist; Marge, the brilliant doctor; Nina, the agile gymnast; and Stacey, the charismatic bartender. These unique characters will charm you with their personalities and skills.

But the adventure doesn't end there! Encounter Ryan and Kent, two charming guys who will add more excitement to your journey.

Explore four enchanting scenes filled with magic and wonder. Immerse yourself in a world where dreams come true and fantasies become reality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39805570/8c79d498e1f6380a5c14aa62d4da7bfdfcc0df7e.gif

Bambie is finally here, step into a World of Plastic, Magic, and hot girls today!
